entry_point: python code/regional_methylation/decode_regional_cpg.py --reference REFERENCE.fa --regions data/regional_methylation/arrays.json --run RUN --primary-bam preserved_primary.mod.bam --parents complete_parent_alignments.tsv.gz --output OUTPUT
alignment_preparation: minimap2 map-ont options in metadata/regional_methylation.json; preserve forward sequence, quality, MM/ML/MN tags when transferring raw calls to primary alignments; include secondary and supplementary rows in parent records; inputs for a sample must be disjoint by read ID
figures: python reproduce.py plot tu; python reproduce.py plot aesculapii; python reproduce.py plot kyathit
note: Whole raw BAMs are available in PRJEB108899. The figure-ready CpG tables are included; starting from them requires no alignment or raw download.
separate_output: render_groups.py tu --output OUTPUT writes only the body and main figure to OUTPUT; cover joining uses the default figures directory.
